title: PublicationIssue
description: A part of a successively published publication such as a periodical or publication volume, often numbered, usually containing a grouping of works such as articles.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog-schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

issueNumber.title: Issue Number
issueNumber.description: Identifies the issue of publication; for example, "iii" or "2".

pageEnd.title: Page End
pageEnd.description: The page on which the work ends; for example "138" or "xvi".

pageStart.title: Page Start
pageStart.description: The page on which the work starts; for example "135" or "xiii".

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Any description of pages that is not separated into pageStart and pageEnd; for example, "1-6, 9, 55" or "10-12, 46-49".
